data.name: Altayyib
data.gender_notes: Altayyib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘t-y-b’, meaning ‘to purify’. It represents the one who is free from sins and impurities, both internally and externally. The name Altayyib carries the meaning “Pure, Innocent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Altayyib usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spiritual purity and righteousness sought by believers.
data.etymology: Altayyib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Innocent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altayyib total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Altayyib holds a deep cultural significance for Muslims as it is a constant reminder of the importance of moral values and purity in the Islamic faith. In Islamic societies and communities, the name is often given to newborns as a reflection of the parents’ hope for their child to grow up to be a virtuous and pure individual. It also serves as an inspiration for children, motivating them to live up to the name and strive towards purifying their souls and actions throughout their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Altayyib holds tremendous significance as it is a reminder for Muslims to constantly work towards achieving purity in both their inner and outer lives. It is a reflection of the belief that a truly devoted Muslim strives to purify their soul from worldly desires and the impurities of sin by following the teachings of Allah and His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). By living a virtuous life that is guided by moral values and away from sin, an individual achieves a state of ultimate spiritual fulfillment and comes closer to Allah.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah. The life of Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf as-Sufyani (d. 658 AD). Al-Hajjaj was given the honorific name 'Altayyib' meaning 'the good' by Umar ibn Abdul-Aziz.
historical_references.context: Umar ibn Abdul-Aziz, the Umayyad caliph, bestowed the name 'Altayyib' ('the good') upon Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf as a mark of respect and admiration for his piety and leadership qualities.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam's Futuh Misr. Description of the invasion of Egypt by the Caliph Omar ibn Al-Khattab (640 AD). Al-Aswad ibn Abd al-Asad was a leader of the Egyptian resistance during the Muslim invasion. He was killed and his head was presented to Caliph Omar. Caliph Omar ordered that his head be buried under the name 'Altayyib' meaning 'the good'.
historical_references.context: Caliph Omar ibn Al-Khattab ordered the burial of Al-Aswad ibn Abd al-Asad's head under the name 'Altayyib' as a mark of respect and acknowledgement of his bravery and leadership during the resistance against the Muslim invasion.

trends: Social media influencers and personal branding
modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Altayyib' is derived from the Arabic language and roughly translates to 'the good, the pure'. In contemporary times, the name has gained popularity in various contexts. It is increasingly used in the context of Islamic spirituality and self-improvement, with many individuals and communities adopting the name as a sign of their commitment to living a virtuous and morally upright life. Social media platforms have played a significant role in popularizing the name, with dedicated hashtags, accounts, and channels featuring content that inspires and educates followers about the importance of living a good and pure life. The name is also associated with Middle Eastern culture and art, and is sometimes used as a brand or label for products and services that evoke a sense of authenticity and tradition. Overall, the name 'Altayyib' represents a modern and vibrant expression of Islamic spirituality and Middle Eastern culture, and can be seen on various social media platforms as a symbol of personal branding and self-expression.
